summary: The final proof and report establish the conjecture under both fractional-word and full-word conventions, with reciprocal transcendental witnesses. No unresolved mathematical or semantic issue remains.

checks.name: bilingual_statement
checks.detail: Both versions assert transcendental existence with Sturmian complexity n+1 and leave the initial index implicit.

checks.name: ordinary_continued_fraction
checks.detail: The same real follows the usual floor-and-invert recursion. Every fractional remainder is proved strictly positive, eliminating artificial continuation after termination.

checks.name: indexing
checks.detail: RESOLVED: The final sources add a reciprocal witness beta=1/alpha whose complete quotient at index n is exactly alpha's complete quotient at index n+1. Consequently the full partial-quotient sequence of beta is 1+b_t(n), including its integer part, and its whole factor set equals the fractional-word factor set of alpha. Its remainders remain positive by the same shift identity. If beta were algebraic, stock IsAlgebraic.inv would imply alpha is algebraic, contradicting the selected witness. The full report states both conventions and correctly allows the two witnesses to differ. This removes the source ambiguity without an unsupported assertion that deleting an arbitrary first letter preserves factor complexity.

checks.name: actual_factor_sets
checks.detail: All natural starting positions are included, Fin n represents contiguous blocks, and separate finiteness protects Set.ncard semantics.

checks.name: exact_complexity
checks.detail: The rank injection proves p(n)<=n+1. No equal suffixes and unique extension prove p(n)>=n+1. This covers every natural length, hence every positive length.

checks.name: realization
checks.detail: Banach contraction with constant 9/16 on the complete uniform-metric space of [1/3,3/4]-valued sequences constructs genuine ordinary continued-fraction tails.

checks.name: injections
checks.detail: Equal mechanical words imply equal slopes by Archimedean floor bounds. Equal realized reals imply equal words by deterministic digit recovery.

checks.name: uncountability_transcendence
checks.detail: The uncountable slope type cannot inject into the countable algebraic-real subtype. The inspected stock definitions give ordinary transcendence over Q.

checks.name: report_complete_reasoning
checks.detail: Entire final report read; all mathematical sections and both final existence assertions match the Lean source.

checks.name: admissions_custom_axioms_source
checks.detail: Direct reading and textual scan of all five Lean files found no admissions, custom axioms, unsafe declarations, native_decide, foreign-code hooks, or numerical assumptions.

checks.name: compiled_axiom_footprint
checks.detail: The source requests suitable audits and the report claims only propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound; parent separately executes verification.

checks.name: clean_checksums
checks.detail: All entries in clean SHA256SUMS.json match.

checks.name: final_hash_binding
checks.detail: Final frozen proof and report hashes match parent-supplied values. Final report was reread following layout changes.
